supported_checks.label_excerpt: Patient fell into a coma after lumbar puncture
supported_checks.source_quote: Two hours later after 30 ml CSF release, the man had complained of progressively worsening dizziness and headache, and then he fell into a coma
supported_checks.explanation: The note supports the coma after lumbar puncture, with dizziness and headache occurring first; the label’s separate symptom entry records this sequence.

supported_checks.source_quote: By then, the patient’s consciousness had been gradually restored
supported_checks.explanation: The label captures the documented improvement after Trendelenburg positioning and hydration.

supported_checks.label_excerpt: Skin flap sank, no obvious midline shift
supported_checks.source_quote: A following brain CT in three days had showed skin flap sank, but no obvious midline shift had been found
supported_checks.explanation: Both CT findings are represented in the result.

findings.label_excerpt: Six months later, GOS of 5, ADL of 18
findings.source_quote: Six months later, the young man got a Glasgow Outcome Scale (GOS) of 5, Activity of Daily Living Scale (ADL) of 18
findings.explanation: The source reports the outcome measures six months later, but does not attribute them as a reaction to the emergent hematoma exclusion. The label places them in the treatment-reaction field, creating an unsupported causal linkage.

findings.source_quote: Five years later, repeated brain CT has revealed complete resolution of
findings.explanation: The note is cut off after “of” and does not establish what was completely resolved. Naming hydrocephalus as the resolved finding completes the truncated result without source support.

findings.source_quote: was sent and treated to our hospital in two hours after the injury
findings.explanation: This supports hospital presentation and treatment, but does not establish admission. The label asserts an admission reason without explicit admission evidence.

findings.source_quote: the CT had disclosed a progressive hydrocephalus compared with three months ago
findings.explanation: The source supports the hydrocephalus finding, but the label omits that it was progressive compared with the CT three months earlier. This loses a material temporal comparison.

findings.source_quote: Thus, the patient was placed in the Trendelenburg position and given sufficient hydration immediately
findings.explanation: The label gives only a broad relation to the lumbar puncture and omits that both interventions were given immediately after the suspected paradoxical herniation symptoms. That timing is material to the documented treatment course.

initial.summary: Candidate findings include an unsupported outcome-to-treatment linkage, completion of a cut-off CT result, an admission assertion without explicit admission evidence, and omitted source-supported qualifiers. The note’s truncation makes the final CT result incomplete.
